note: The durable error-code table for the schema-1 envelope. Codes may be added, never renamed, with one exception: the release that introduced the W_ prefix moved thirty warnings from an E_ name to the W_ name with the same stem. Five of them are CDP faults a session carries on past, so the exception also covers the cdpFaultCode value in ready.json, a contract field whose values were renamed with them. A code retired after it shipped keeps a 'folded' row naming the code the same path reports now. A folded row is a record for a reader of this table: nothing at run time reads it, no envelope carries a folded name and no alias exists, so a consumer that matches a folded name has to switch to the code the row names. A W_ code is a warning: the run carried on past it. An E_ code is a failure. A class that can do both has one row under each prefix with the same stem. Eleven of the thirty E_ names that moved never marked a failure, and each has a 'folded' row naming its W_ name. One code per operator-distinguishable failure family. The envelope's command field carries the which-command context. 'folded' records finer inventory names that map onto a shipped family code. 'legacy' maps the three pre-envelope conventions (snake_case ready.json codes, PascalCase error names, kebab-case doctor check ids) onto the table. A ready.json id that lists several codes resolves to the first unless the contract's browserLaunchFailedCode names another from the list. A row marked 'reserved' names a failure the CLI does not report under that code today, so no envelope carries it yet and a consumer need not handle it. Its 'reason' says what keeps it reserved.

E_ARGS.summary: A required argument is missing or the invocation is malformed.

E_INVALID_OPTION.summary: A flag or argument value is not in the accepted set.

E_FLAG_NOT_SUPPORTED_HERE.summary: The flag exists but does not apply to this command or target.

E_REMOVED_FLAG.summary: The flag was removed from the CLI.

E_UNKNOWN_COMMAND.summary: No subcommand matches the given name.

E_NODE_VERSION.summary: The running Node version is below the supported minimum.

E_COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_TARGET.summary: The command does not support the requested browser target.

E_UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER.summary: The requested vendor is not in the supported browser list.

E_BROWSER_NOT_INSTALLABLE.summary: The browser is a known target but has no managed download; the CLI cannot fetch it.

E_PARENT_GONE.summary: The --parent-pid owner died, so the dev server self-terminated.

E_REMOTE_URL_UNSUPPORTED.summary: The operation does not accept a remote URL.

E_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.summary: The resolved project folder does not exist.

E_CONFIG_LOAD.summary: extension.config.js threw while loading or did not export an object.

E_OPTIONAL_DEP_UNRESOLVED.summary: An optional dependency contract could not be resolved.

E_OPTIONAL_DEP_LOAD.summary: An optional dependency resolved but failed to load.

E_COMPANION_EXTENSION_PATH.summary: A companion extension entry is refused: it leads outside the project, it is neither a store link nor a folder path, or the only manifest at the resolved root belongs to a companion under extensions/.

E_FOLDER_UNREADABLE.summary: A folder inside pages/ or scripts/ cannot be read, so the build cannot list its entries.

E_RUNTIME_NOT_FOUND.summary: The extension-develop runtime is missing, uncompiled or at another version than the CLI.

E_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND.summary: No manifest.json at the resolved root.

E_MANIFEST_INVALID.summary: The manifest is not parseable JSON or not a WebExtension manifest.

E_FIRST_COMPILE.summary: The first compile of a session failed, so nothing was loaded.

E_COMPILE_FATAL.summary: The compiler itself failed or returned unusable stats.

E_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.summary: A module specifier could not be resolved.

E_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.summary: A manifest, HTML, or JSON entry points at a file that is missing or not bundled.

E_ASSET_MISSING.summary: An icon, static asset, or JSON dependency is missing or not bundled.

E_SCRIPT_DEP_MISSING.summary: A file a script loads at runtime is missing from the build, is named by its source spelling, or could not be compiled.

E_RESERVED_FOLDER.summary: A reserved scripts/ folder shape was violated.

E_CSS_PREPROCESSOR_MISSING.summary: A CSS preprocessor is requested but not resolvable.

E_CSS_DEAD_REF.summary: A CSS url() or @import names a file that is missing or not bundled.

E_WAR_INVALID.summary: web_accessible_resources shape or match pattern rejected.

E_THEME_INVALID.summary: A theme color or tint is not a number array a Chromium browser loads, and the build cannot translate it exactly.

E_DEV_SESSION_DIST_SHARED.summary: A build would write the dist folder a running dev session serves, so it was refused; pass --out-dir to build beside it.

E_BACKGROUND_REQUIRED.summary: The reload runtime needs a background chunk that is absent.
E_BACKGROUND_REQUIRED.reason: A missing background script is reported by the scripts feature as E_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND in every mode, so the reload pipeline raises this code nowhere.

E_CONTENT_SCRIPT_SYNTAX.summary: A content script failed to parse.

E_PERF_BUDGET.summary: An asset exceeds its size budget, and the project asked for that to fail the build. It is the same overrun W_PERF_BUDGET warns of, made strict.

E_ZIP_SKIPPED.summary: A requested archive was not created.

E_REMOTE_FETCH_TIMEOUT.summary: A remote fetch exceeded its timeout.

E_REMOTE_DOWNLOAD.summary: A remote extension could not be downloaded or written to disk.

E_REMOTE_ACCESS_DENIED.summary: The server refused access to the remote URL with a 401 or 403, so its access token has expired, was revoked, or was changed while copying.

E_REMOTE_ZIP_INVALID.summary: The remote URL did not return a ZIP, returned a damaged one that will not unpack, or one with an entry outside its folder.

E_LOCAL_ZIP_NOT_FOUND.summary: A referenced local zip is missing or not a zip.

E_PROJECT_DOWNLOAD_EMPTY.summary: Download succeeded but the extracted folder is absent.

E_NETWORK.summary: A network request failed or timed out.

E_BROWSER_NOT_FOUND.summary: No installed binary for the requested vendor.

E_BROWSER_BINARY_REQUIRED.summary: A -based target needs an explicit binary path.

E_BROWSER_BINARY_INVALID.summary: The given binary path does not exist, is not executable, or does not answer its version probe within 10 seconds.

E_BROWSER_LAUNCH.summary: The browser process failed to spawn or died at startup.

E_BROWSER_EXITED.summary: The launched browser exited while the server kept running.

E_BROWSER_START_TIMEOUT.summary: The browser accepted the debug socket but never sent its greeting.

E_PROFILE_LOCKED.summary: The profile directory is held by another browser process.

E_INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS.summary: More than one live instance matches the requested id.

E_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.summary: Downloading or installing a browser failed.

E_BROWSER_INSTALL_PRIVILEGE.summary: The install needs an interactive privileged session.

E_BROWSER_INSTALL_TIMEOUT.summary: The browser installer was still running at the install timeout and was stopped.

E_BROWSER_INSTALL_BUSY.summary: Another install of the same browser was still running after the whole wait, so this one never started.

E_BROWSER_CACHE_NOT_WRITABLE.summary: The browser cache root is a file, cannot be created or cannot be written to.

E_BROWSER_FOLDER_FOREIGN.summary: The browser folder in the cache holds files the installers never write, so the install left it untouched.

E_BROWSER_INSTALLER_NOT_FOUND.summary: The package runner that installs the browser is not on this machine.

E_EXTENSION_LOAD_REFUSED.summary: The browser refused the unpacked extension.

E_BROWSER_CONNECT.summary: The debug connection could not be opened.

E_CDP_NOT_CONNECTED.summary: An operation was issued with no live CDP transport.

E_CDP_TIMEOUT.summary: A CDP command or load event timed out.

E_CDP_OP_FAILED.summary: An extension operation over CDP failed.

E_EXTENSION_ID_UNKNOWN.summary: The extension id could not be determined over CDP.

E_RDP_PROTOCOL.summary: A malformed or unexpected RDP exchange.

E_DEV_SERVER_START.summary: The dev server failed to start.

E_PORT_UNAVAILABLE.summary: No free port could be bound near the requested one: the dev server port, or the browser debugging port a launch claims.

E_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.summary: No live session contract for this project and browser.

E_SESSION_STOPPED.summary: The session contract reports a stopped session.

E_SESSION_EXISTS.summary: A live dev session already owns this project and browser, so the new session was refused.

E_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.summary: The dev session did not stop within its shutdown bound, so the process ended anyway with exit code 1.

E_READY_TIMEOUT.summary: --wait expired before the session became ready.

E_READY_ERROR_STATUS.summary: The ready contract reports an error for this session.

E_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE.summary: The control channel is absent, mismatched, or not answering.

E_CONTROL_DENIED.summary: The session refused the control operation.

E_TOKEN_MISSING.summary: The operation needs a session token that is not present.

E_EVAL_REFUSED.summary: Eval is disabled for the session or the token does not match.

E_CSP_BLOCKS_EVAL.summary: A content security policy forbids eval in the target, the extension's own for its documents and its content-script world or the page's own for a web page, so the in-page executor runs no expression there.

E_TIMEOUT.summary: The operation did not answer inside its timeout.

E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.summary: The operation is not implemented for this context or engine.

E_TARGET_NOT_FOUND.summary: No tab, frame, or context matched the requested target.

E_HEADED_WINDOW_REQUIRED.summary: The surface needs a headed browser window this session does not have.

E_USER_GESTURE_REQUIRED.summary: The surface needs a real user gesture the caller cannot synthesize.

E_EVAL.summary: The evaluated expression threw inside the page, whatever the class of the error it threw.

E_INSPECT.summary: DOM inspection failed inside the guest.

E_STORAGE.summary: chrome.storage rejected the read or write.

E_LOGS_NOT_FOUND.summary: No logs stream for this project and browser.

E_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.summary: The template is not in the catalog or has no manifest.

E_DESTINATION_NOT_EMPTY.summary: The destination already holds conflicting files.

E_DESTINATION_NOT_WRITABLE.summary: The destination directory, or a file the scaffold writes in it, is not writable.

E_OUTPUT_NOT_WRITABLE.summary: The build could not write manifest.json into the output folder.

E_PREVIEW_NO_DIST.summary: No unpacked extension at the resolved output path.

E_SAFARI_TOOLCHAIN.summary: The Safari toolchain is unavailable or an invocation failed.

E_SAFARI_UI.summary: A read or action on Safari's own settings or toolbar failed.

E_ACCESSIBILITY_DENIED.summary: macOS has not granted the host app Accessibility, so Safari's own UI can't be read or driven.

E_AUTH_REQUIRED.summary: The operation needs an auth token that is not present.

E_TELEMETRY_WRITE.summary: A telemetry file could not be written or removed.

E_DOCTOR_CHECKS_FAILED.summary: One or more doctor checks reported fail.

E_INTERRUPTED.summary: The operation was interrupted before it finished.

E_INTERNAL.summary: An unexpected fault reached the top-level sink.

E_RESTART_REQUIRED.summary: A file the running dev session depends on was removed or changed in a way it cannot apply, so the session must be restarted.

E_JSON_INVALID.summary: A JSON file the manifest names does not parse, or its declarativeNetRequest ruleset or managed storage schema has a shape the browser rejects.

E_PROJECT_LAYOUT.summary: A file in public/ would overwrite a file the build emits, or an include entry in extension.config.js names a missing file or an output path outside the extension.

E_ASSET_IMPORT_SHAPE.summary: An asset imported with import * as is read as the file's value, which is the default export.

E_ENV_FILE_UNREADABLE.summary: A .env file the build has to read for its browser and mode is a folder or cannot be read.

W_MANAGED_DEP_CONFLICT.summary: The project declares a package the toolchain manages.

W_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.summary: A module specifier could not be resolved, and the build carried on without it.

W_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.summary: A manifest, HTML, or JSON entry points at a file that is missing or not bundled.

W_ASSET_MISSING.summary: An icon, static asset, or JSON dependency is missing or not bundled.

W_SCRIPT_DEP_MISSING.summary: A file a script loads at runtime is missing from the build, is named by its source spelling, or could not be compiled.

W_CSS_PREPROCESSOR_MISSING.summary: A CSS preprocessor is requested but not resolvable.

W_CSS_DEAD_REF.summary: A CSS url() or @import names a file that is missing or not bundled.

W_PROD_LOOPBACK_ORIGIN.summary: A production manifest names a loopback origin (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, [::1] or 0.0.0.0), which store reviewers read as unexplained host access.

W_REMOTE_RESOURCE_BLOCKED.summary: A remote script or stylesheet is blocked by extension CSP.

W_PERF_BUDGET.summary: An asset exceeds its size budget.

W_LAUNCH_SKIPPED_COMPILE_ERRORS.summary: Launch was withheld because the compile failed.

W_PORT_IN_USE.summary: The requested port was taken and auto-reassigned.

W_MANIFEST_INVALID.summary: A manifest field had a shape the browser refuses to load, and the build repaired or dropped it.

W_WAR_INVALID.summary: A web_accessible_resources pattern leaves the extension root, so it exposes no file.

W_RESERVED_FOLDER.summary: A file in scripts/ is only imported by another file, and every file in that folder is built as an entry of its own.

W_INTERNAL.summary: A build step met output it did not expect and carried on. The toolchain needs an update.

W_RESTART_REQUIRED.summary: A file the running dev session reads only at startup changed, so the change applies after a restart.

W_JSON_INVALID.summary: A declarativeNetRequest ruleset parses but has a rule that may not behave as written, or one that Chrome refuses and Firefox loads.

W_PROJECT_LAYOUT.summary: A public/ folder is misplaced, shadowed by another one or spelled in another letter case, a public/ file is not copied because the build writes that output path from an entry, or an exclude entry in extension.config.js names a file that is not there.

W_MANIFEST_COMPAT.summary: The manifest uses a version, key or host permission pattern that the target browser ignores or is phasing out.

W_STORE_READINESS.summary: The manifest builds and loads, but a store would reject or flag it as written.

W_PERMISSION_MISMATCH.summary: The code uses an API or reaches a host that the manifest permissions do not cover the way the code needs.

W_API_UNSUPPORTED.summary: The code calls an extension API, or a form of one, that the target browser does not have.

W_WAR_EXPOSURE.summary: A file a script names is not reachable through web_accessible_resources, or the build exposed it more widely than the manifest lists.

W_CSS_NOT_APPLIED.summary: A stylesheet import or url() is kept in the output but the browser will not apply it where it sits.

W_ENV_SECRET_PUBLIC.summary: An EXTENSION_PUBLIC_ variable has a name that looks like a secret, and its value is written into the built code.

W_BUILD_CONSTANT_UNDEFINED.summary: A script reads a build constant that nothing defines, so it throws when it loads.

W_SCRIPT_WORLD_UNKNOWN.summary: A script is registered at runtime with a world the build cannot read, so it is treated as an isolated world script.

W_ENV_NAME_RESERVED.summary: A .env file sets a name the build reserves for the browser or mode it compiles for, so the file value is ignored.

W_COMPANION_EXTENSION_PATH.summary: A companion extension entry leads outside the project, is not an unpacked extension folder, or names a folder that does not exist, so the browser opens without it.

W_ENV_DEFINE_WRITTEN.summary: Project code writes to a process.env or import.meta.env name the build replaces with its value. The write runs, and reads of that name keep the build value.

W_ENV_ASSET_NOT_UTF8.summary: An emitted .json or .html file holds a $EXTENSION_ placeholder but is not UTF-8 text, so it ships byte for byte and the placeholder is left as written.

W_HTML_NOT_UTF8.summary: An HTML page of the extension is not UTF-8 text. A page that declares its charset is converted to UTF-8, and one that does not ships with a replacement character for each byte that is not UTF-8.

W_CDP_NOT_CONNECTED.summary: A dev, start or preview session came up with no live CDP transport and stayed ready. Reload and HMR cannot attach.

W_CDP_TIMEOUT.summary: A CDP command or load timed out after launch, and the dev, start or preview session stayed ready. Reload and HMR cannot attach.

W_CDP_OP_FAILED.summary: An extension operation over CDP failed after launch, and the dev, start or preview session stayed ready. Reload and HMR cannot attach. A fault of any class other than the four with a warning name of their own is reported under this code too.

W_BROWSER_CONNECTION_CLOSED.summary: The debug socket closed after launch, and the dev, start or preview session stayed ready. Reload and HMR cannot attach.

W_EXTENSION_ID_UNKNOWN.summary: The extension id could not be determined over CDP after launch, and the dev, start or preview session stayed ready. Reload and HMR cannot attach.
